name: Killswitch
source:
You randomly reconnect with your best friend from your childhood. However, the more time you spend in his company as you rekindle your friendship you realize that perhaps your meeting with him after all this time wasn't such a random event after all...

[From [url=https://heychevy0s.itch.io/killswitch]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你随机地与童年时最好的朋友重新联系。然而，当你在他的陪伴下度过的时间越多，当你重新点燃你们的友谊时，你就会意识到，也许你和他的相遇毕竟不是一次偶然的事件……

[来自[url=https://heychevy0s.itch.io/killswitch]Itch.io[/url]]
